verdict.summary: Round 4 remains correct and complete on the supplied diff. Timestamp candidates are parsed before comparison, malformed values cannot poison winner selection, offset-aware values are ordered by instant, and naive values are consistently interpreted as UTC. The focused tests cover the timestamp helper, direct winner selection, and the real stale-scanner trigger while isolating it from the missing-reference fallback. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect is evident. Round 3 also had no findings and the relevant implementation is materially unchanged, so progress is stagnant.
